entries.name: explicit-type-args-none-tree#0
entries.description: sigmaProp(Global.none[Int].isDefined) — PropertyCall (no arguments): the type byte follows the object directly (PropertyCallSerializer.scala:24). An implementation that does not read the trailing type re-serializes the tree without it, one byte shorter, and the declared size shrinks: a NON-identity round-trip and a different script hash.
